{{Quote|I did not say 'soon.' I said ''now!''<nowiki></nowiki>|Saz Tyrson|<ref name="AB" />}}
'''Saz Tyrson''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who became a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Tyrson took the forces under his command after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and controlled over two dozen [[Star system/Legends|systems]], supported by his military. He was present aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Stellar Mermaid]]'' for [[Sard Nightbringer]]'s auction of the experimental [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shield]].<ref name="AB" />

==Personality and traits==
He had a slightly aged and rough look, he also wore a slightly altered imperial uniform. Dangerous, hot-tempered, and forceful, Tyrson was only loyal to himself, and became an independent warlord after the Battle of Endor. Tyrson was 55 years of age.<ref name="AB" />
